request: Build a sales opportunity pipeline: each opportunity has a name, a customer, an estimated value and an expected close date, and moves through Lead, Qualified, Proposal, then Won or Lost.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Opportunity" with 4 fields:
  - State (one of "Lead", "Qualified", "Proposal", "Won", "Lost", required)
  - Opportunity name (text, required)
  - Estimated value (whole number)
  - Expected close date (date)
  It gets its own menu entry "Opportunity" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Opportunity records.
New optional link "Customer" from Opportunity to Party. Choose it when creating a record.
New lifecycle for Opportunity. Records start at "Lead".
  - Qualify changes "Lead" to "Qualified" after confirmation.
  - Send proposal changes "Qualified" to "Proposal" after confirmation.
  - Mark won changes "Proposal" to "Won" after confirmation.
  - Mark lost from lead changes "Lead" to "Lost" after confirmation.
  - Mark lost from qualified changes "Qualified" to "Lost" after confirmation.
  - Mark lost from proposal changes "Proposal" to "Lost" after confirmation.

Stored data: a new table, 2 new indexes, addForeignKey. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
